title: The platform builder
text:
The platform builder. A profile of Runa Okonkwo.

They meet us at a coffee place on the east side, order nothing, and talk for two hours about queues.

Okonkwo grew up in Port Harcourt and moved to Texas for a job they left after fourteen months. They started Quarrystone Labs with two people they met on a mailing list.

Away from the company Okonkwo is a competent but unenthusiastic runner. Okonkwo and their spouse Delia Moreno-Vance keep a small workshop of half-finished furniture, and neither of them will say which of the two is worse at finishing anything.

The team describes Okonkwo as the person who asks what happens when this fails, every time, until somebody has an answer.
